@graph.name: Security Evacuation
@graph.description: Learn about Travel Guard’s Security Evacuation coverage before heading on your trip to understand how Travel Guard can assist with your safety in certain unexpected events.

acceptedAnswer.text: Security Evacuation coverage is a coverage available on select Travel Guard travel insurance plans that provides coverage for evacuating you from certain dangerous situations. If you find yourself in this type of situation, typical resources that you might use for securing travel arrangements may be unavailable. Travel Guard’s specialized team can make all necessary arrangements once an evacuation has been determined as necessary.

mainEntity.name: How do I use the Security Evacuation benefit during my trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must contact Travel Guard when you think you need a Security Evacuation. Travelers can contact our 24/7 travel emergency services team for assistance with assessing the situation to determine if a Security Evacuation is required. If an evacuation is deemed necessary, Travel Guard will make all travel arrangements to the nearest point of safety.

mainEntity.name: What documentation do I need to file a claim for Security Evacuation?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Security Evacuations are more involved than other situations, so the specific documentation needed for your claim will depend on the situation you were in.

- Below is a list of documentation that may be required. 

- Travel Guard claim form

- Receipts for any transportation expenses 

Receipts for items like food and lodging during transport to the Nearest Place of Safety, as defined in the travel insurance plan.

There may be additional documents required based on your specific claim. You can start the process of filing a claim online with our claims portal or you can call us directly if you have specific questions.

mainEntity.name: Is Security Evacuation a part of my plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Security Evacuation coverage is a part of the Deluxe Plan from Travel Guard, or as a part of the  Security Bundle optional upgrade to the Preferred and Essential plans, which adds more coverage for your trip.

mainEntity.name: Can I just get coverage for Security Evacuation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Since Security Evacuation is a coverage included on the Deluxe Plan or as an optional upgrade to your Preferred or Essential Travel Guard travel insurance plan, it’s not possible to only get coverage for this specific coverage only. However, a travel insurance plan offers a variety of coverages that travelers may find useful, such as Trip Delay, Baggage Coverage, Trip Interruption and more.
